data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2026 in Marbella is one of the summer's most anticipated music events, drawing international artists and thousands of fans to the Auditorio in the hills above the Golden Mile. But why limit your evening to just the concert? Combine your Starlite night with a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús for a seamless VIP experience. Cruise the Costa del Sol at sunset, sip cava as the sun dips behind La Concha, then head to the festival feeling like a star. Here's how to plan it.

Why Combine a Yacht Charter with Starlite Festival?

Starlite Festival 2026 runs from July to August, with concerts starting around 21:00. A yacht charter lets you turn the hours before the show into a mini-vacation. Depart from Puerto Banús at 17:00, enjoy a 2-hour sunset cruise along the coast, and arrive back at port by 19:00. You'll have time to change and take a 15-minute taxi to the Auditorio. The contrast between the calm sea and the electric atmosphere of the festival is unforgettable.

Our Fleet for Starlite Festival 2026

We offer a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús, all with licensed skippers, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance included. Here are the best options for a concert evening:

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are perfect for couples or small groups. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) include a free jet ski and are ideal for a luxury pre-party. For other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Azimut 58 Flybridge, pricing is available via WhatsApp.

Sample Evening: Sunset Cruise + Starlite

Here's a typical plan for a Starlite evening:

  • 17:00 – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.
  • 17:15 – Depart towards Cabopino or Cala del Faro. Enjoy the coast, swim if you like.
  • 18:30 – Anchor for sunset. Cava, snacks, and music on board.
  • 19:00 – Return to Puerto Banús.
  • 19:30 – Disembark. Quick change and taxi to Auditorio (15 min).
  • 21:00 – Concert begins. You're relaxed and ready.

This schedule works with a 2-hour charter. For a longer day, book an 8-hour charter (€2,299) and explore Estepona or Sotogrande before returning.

What's Included in Every Charter

All our charters include: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. The Mangusta 80 also includes a free jet ski.

Best Boats for Different Groups

  • Couples: Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – intimate and affordable.
  • Small groups (up to 11): Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 – great value at €749/2h.
  • Larger groups (up to 12): Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or Ferretti 94 – luxury with space.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, putting you minutes from the festival.

How to Book for Starlite Festival 2026

Demand spikes during festival season, so book early. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing for any boat not listed with fixed rates. We recommend reserving at least 2-3 months in advance. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For others, we'll confirm within 24 hours.
